name: What kind of equipment do professionals use for sink overflow cleanup?

mainEntity.name: What kind of equipment do professionals use for sink overflow cleanup?

acceptedAnswer.text: Professionals utilize a range of specialized equipment for efficient sink overflow cleanup. This includes powerful water extractors and wet vacuums for removing standing water, industrial-strength air movers and axial fans to circulate air and speed up evaporation, and commercial-grade dehumidifiers to draw moisture out of the air and materials. Moisture meters and thermal imaging cameras are also used to detect hidden moisture within walls, floors, and ceilings. This equipment ensures thorough drying and prevents long-term problems like mold or structural damage.
acceptedAnswer.description: Professionals use specialized equipment like water extractors, air movers, dehumidifiers, and moisture detection tools to thoroughly remove water, dry affected areas, and prevent hidden damage.
